const response = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { approvalId: response.id, status: response.status, expiresAt: response.expiresAt, publicApprovalUrl: response.token ? `${$env.LEADOPS_PORTAL_URL}/approval/public/${response.token}` : null } }];

const value = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { errorName: 'ApprovalRequestError', errorCode: 'APPROVAL_REQUEST_FAILED', statusCode: Number(value.statusCode || 0), message: String(value.message || 'Approval request failed').slice(0, 300) } }];
